title: Euchromatin and Heterochromatin: Organization and Differences
method: Whitespace-separated visible teaching paragraphs in 14 theory sections, excluding tables, figures, captions, practice, references and UI; total article includes headings, captions, tables, practice and references, excluding SVG and buttons.
comparator: 2.C.03: 7564 narrative words, 17 sections; 2.B.10: 9074, 21 sections. Narrower 2.C.09 covers all roadmap topics in 14 narrative sections; detailed regulatory pathways remain in 3.D.
scientific_checks: Two editorial passes; strengthened DNA vs histone methylation, X-specific probe and XIST evidence, perturbation controls, corrected diagrams and separated questions from answers. Official merged and separate CSIR syllabus and archived MP SET 2024 comparator checked visually. Alberts, Allshire and Madhani, Elgin and Reuter, Eberl et al., XCI escape and dosage-compensation references consulted. Checked cytological staining, nucleosomes and accessibility, centromeric vs pericentromeric organization, HP1 and local maintenance, constitutive vs facultative, XCI counts and escape, replication timing, position-effect variegation, native heterochromatic genes, independent assay controls, and numerical answers. Original questions and schematic diagrams.
limitations: Static source and arithmetic audit; no independent human reviewer, interactive browser/device or rendered SVG/accessibility test. MP SET source is archived rather than current original MPPSC-hosted document. Immediate neighbors not yet published at baseline. Live Pages verification pending.
